The evidence comes from two different ledgers (Tenant 3 and Tenant 4), and they conflict. Tenant 3 says Harbor Printing has the largest balance, at 3,600. Tenant 4 says Delta Cleaning has the largest, at 5,200, after an audit correction.

The question doesn't name a tenant. Tenant 4's note says its figure comes after an audit correction, which suggests it is the more current or authoritative record. Its 5,200 for Delta Cleaning is also higher than any Tenant 3 balance, including Delta Cleaning's 3,000 there.

The two ledgers may cover different tenants, so they may not describe the same invoices. Since the question names no tenant, the best-supported answer is the one reflecting the audit correction, which is Delta Cleaning.

**D**
